title: Experimental VLE, consistency and fitting
pause_instruction: Advance to the schedule. No calculation or worksheet entry is required on the title slide.

title: A three-hour independent lesson
pause_instruction: Read the schedule, then advance. The 180 minutes include independent work and the break.

title: Preparation · 0–10 min
pause_instruction: Open worksheet pages 1–4, prepare a calculator and paper, and resume with the composition review at about minute 10. Do not open the Lab yet.

title: 1. Composition and phase amount · 10–15 min
pause_instruction: Read the symbol definitions and material balance on this slide. No worksheet entry is required. Advance when ready for A1–A3.

title: Pause and calculate · 15–23 min
pause_instruction: Pause and complete worksheet page 1, A1–A3, with a calculator. Resume at the phase-check slide after attempting all three items.

title: Phase check · 23–27 min
pause_instruction: Check and correct worksheet page 1, A1–A3. Explain any changed phase classification before advancing.

title: Pause: material balance · 27–32 min
pause_instruction: Pause and complete worksheet page 1, A4. Show the substituted material balance and both phase-composition sums.

title: Material-balance check · 32–35 min
pause_instruction: Check worksheet page 1, A4. Retain the substituted balance and correct composition sums before advancing.

title: 2. Starting from Raoult’s law · 35–39 min
pause_instruction: On scratch paper, calculate 60 divided by 48. Think about what this ratio compares, then advance.

title: A new quantity: activity coefficient · 39–42 min
pause_instruction: Compare gamma = 1.25 with your scratch calculation. Read the assumptions, then advance; no Lab or worksheet entry is required.

title: Activity and its reference · 42–45 min
pause_instruction: Check 1.25 times 0.4 on your calculator. Read the reference-state statement and keep worksheet B blank until the exercise at minute 48.

title: Calculating gamma from VLE · 45–48 min
pause_instruction: Read the rearranged equation and its assumptions. Have worksheet page 1, B1–B3 ready for the next slide.

title: Pause: one observation, two property inputs · 48–57 min
pause_instruction: Pause and complete worksheet page 1, B1–B3. Use only the observation on this slide; no Lab is needed.

title: A property error changes inferred activity · 57–65 min
pause_instruction: Check worksheet page 1, B1–B3, correct the calculations, and finish the explanation in B3 before continuing to Antoine conventions.

title: 3. Antoine conventions · 65–72 min
pause_instruction: Pause to read the Antoine convention checks and locate Section C on worksheet page 2. Do not start Section D. Continue at minute 72.

title: Pause: Antoine calculation · 72–82 min
pause_instruction: Pause and complete worksheet page 2, C1–C4. Show substitutions. Do not open the solution until you have attempted all four questions. Continue at minute 82.

title: Antoine check · 82–90 min
pause_instruction: Pause to correct worksheet page 2, C1–C4 and explain any errors. Begin the break at minute 90.

title: Break · 90–100 min
pause_instruction: Pause for a ten-minute break. At minute 100, open Lab 08 using the slide link and continue to the baseline instructions.

title: 4. Lab baseline · 100–110 min
pause_instruction: Pause to complete page 2, D1–D2 in Lab 08. Validate the synthetic example, leave No extrapolation selected, and save the baseline complete study JSON. Continue at minute 110.

title: Pause: an independent Lab check · 110–120 min
pause_instruction: Pause to complete page 2, D3 and page 3, E1 using the same interior row and component 1. Compare gamma with exp(table ln gamma), not directly with ln gamma. Continue at minute 120.

title: Model comparison · 120–135 min
pause_instruction: Pause to complete page 3, E2. Fit both models, use View: Pressure and vapor residuals, and save each model's complete study JSON and fitted residuals CSV before switching. Continue at minute 135.

title: Interpreting the comparison · 135–145 min
pause_instruction: Pause to complete worksheet page 3, F using your E2 results. Include a finding, numerical evidence with units, and a limitation. Continue at minute 145.

title: Review test: purpose · 145–147 min
pause_instruction: Read the review-test instructions on worksheet page 4. Keep original answers and corrections. Continue to Q1–Q3 at minute 147.

title: Review test: phase and activity · 147–155 min
pause_instruction: Pause and answer worksheet page 4, Q1–Q3 individually. Use each question's own data and show calculations. Continue at minute 155.

title: Review test: properties and evidence · 155–165 min
pause_instruction: Pause and complete worksheet page 4, Q4–Q6. Use your own page 3, E2 results for Q6. Finish before advancing to the solutions at minute 165.

title: Review solutions · 165–169 min
pause_instruction: Pause to check page 4, Q1–Q4 and add corrections beside the original calculations. Use extra paper if needed. Continue at minute 169.

title: Review of reasoning · 169–172 min
pause_instruction: Pause to check page 4, Q5–Q6 and explain corrections. Retain worksheet pages 1–4 and all Lab exports. Continue to the exit ticket at minute 172.

title: Exit ticket and feedback · 172–180 min
pause_instruction: Pause to complete the Session 2 exit ticket and feedback form. Wait for Response received. Keep worksheet pages 1–4 and Lab exports for attendance submission through the separately provided route. Finish at approximately minute 180.
